entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Climactic confrontation to save Innistrad from Emrakul and Nahiri.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose invasion threatened Innistrad; imprisoned in the Innistrad Moon.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Lithomancer planeswalker seeking vengeance whose cultists tried to complete the summoning of Emrakul.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City on Innistrad and stronghold of the Order of Saint Traft where the battle took place.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Knights of Thraben commanded by Thalia.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire leader of the vampire army.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Guardian of Thraben commanding the Order of Saint Traft knights.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Archangel untouched by madness who slew Brisela.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: Eldrazi spawn of Emrakul created from the fused bodies of Bruna and Gisela.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped imprison Emrakul in the Innistrad Moon.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped imprison Emrakul in the Innistrad Moon.

entities.name: Innistrad Moon
entities.description: Moon within which Emrakul was imprisoned.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose protective presence was absent.

events.summary: Vampires, angels, humans and planeswalkers unite at Thraben against Emrakul and Nahiri's cultists.
events.quote: Together, they formed a coalition to resist the Eldrazi and the cultists loyal to Nahiri.

events.summary: Liliana uses her undead army to hold critical positions.
events.quote: Liliana’s strategic use of her undead army to hold critical positions

events.summary: Sigarda slays Brisela, the turning point of the battle.
events.quote: Sigarda , the archangel untouched by madness, confronted and slew Brisela

events.summary: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul within the Innistrad Moon.
events.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo succeeded in imprisoning Emrakul within the Innistrad Moon

events.summary: The victory ends the Eldrazi invasion and Nahiri's campaign of vengeance.
events.quote: The victory at Thraben marked the end of the Eldrazi invasion and Nahiri’s campaign of vengeance.
